candidates.reason: Aggregate by pickup timestamp, then combine counts by extracted hour. The BIGINT cast preserves COUNT(*)'s DuckDB type, including the NULL-hour group.
candidates.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, CAST(SUM(n) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT tpep_pickup_datetime, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trips GROUP BY tpep_pickup_datetime) AS grouped GROUP BY 1

candidates.reason: Use a partitioned window count and DISTINCT to produce one row per hour, preserving duplicate contributions and the NULL-hour group.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips

candidates.reason: Aggregate by route and pickup timestamp before applying the unchanged calendar-day predicate, then combine route counts. Casting the sum to BIGINT preserves the original count type.
candidates.sql: SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, CAST(SUM(n) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT PULocationID, DOLocationID, tpep_pickup_datetime, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID, tpep_pickup_datetime) AS grouped WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7 GROUP BY 1, 2

candidates.reason: Apply the original date predicate before window counting, then deduplicate route rows. NULL route keys remain grouped together and every qualifying duplicate contributes to the BIGINT count.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7
